observation.highestConfidenceMinimalRevisionSlice: a separate second leading Learn transaction revises the immediately-prior Knowledge claim to the same value, preserving exact atomic receipt boundaries while exercising real reinforcement semantics

routing.reason: After Cycle 92 closed the derived-Knowledge runtime-truth artifact, revision semantics became the highest-value executable gap: parser, type system, Reference Runtime, Knowledge record fields, native typed records and ordered multi-Learn lowering are already mature, while canonical native lowering still rejects every revision. The bottleneck is concentrated in compiler/lowering and receipt-preserving transaction semantics rather than a missing product surface, so NORTH_STAR re-observation routes into DEEP_DEVELOPMENT. The first slice is deliberately limited to same-value reinforcement in a separate second leading Learn so one Learn remains one atomic transaction and exact receipt/root parity can be proven.

deliveryConstraint.validationSurface: Vercel Preview runs the entire Cycle 92 regression chain, bounded reinforcement-revision unit/negative controls, then executes the candidate through the exact canonical real-C Native VM and requires semantic state root plus two-transaction Knowledge receipt parity.
